name: kettlebell standing bottoms up one arm shoulder press
description: A one-arm overhead press holding the kettlebell upside down, which demands wrist and shoulder control.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle and brace your core.
Press the bell straight overhead, keeping it balanced.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
